evidence.decision: Distinguishes positional range from filled capacity, temporary work and rating; requires real units/endpoints before style/threshold choices.
evidence.artifact: Delivers quantity/range/style/threshold contract with corrected gauge implementation or annotated design.
evidence.transformation: Unlabeled red 80 with tiny blocks becomes continuous 80 GB of 100 GB used with explained noncolor warning meaning.
evidence.verification: Checks endpoints, unknown/out-of-range input, compact layout and noncolor cues; reversed scale, false precision or unlabeled capacity fails.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies Mac continuous/discrete level indicators and TV exclusion; accessible/native announcements remain separate verification.
evidence.handoffs: Progress indicators, Rating indicators and Widgets load according to temporary completion, ranking or accessory presentation.
evidence.distinctiveness: Range meaning, endpoint context and whole-unit versus continuous capacity are specific gauge decisions.
